external_primary_findings.finding: Chat models consume token sequences produced from role/content structures through model-specific chat templates; Transformers recommends apply_chat_template(..., tokenize=True) for direct tokenization and warns that special-token handling changes the sequence.
The chat template is renderer logic stored on the tokenizer; template inputs/flags and special tokens participate in rendering, so renderer identity/configuration is part of cost provenance.

A concrete model artifact carries explicit chat_template plus special token IDs, demonstrating that tokenizer/template artifacts are model-specific cost inputs. Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct is only an example, not a canonical Frankenstein 2.0 model selection.
